regressionBeforeFix.command: pnpm exec vitest run src/__tests__/lib/codex-session/bootstrap-delivery.test.ts -t 'shared workspace app transport deadlines'
regressionBeforeFix.reason: Both recovery paths inherited the ten-second cookie-exchange deadline, rejecting delayed cookie exchanges and combined cookie-plus-POST requests before their thirty-second request deadline.

coverage: Six-second cookie exchange plus six-second POST succeeds for each recovery path.
Eleven-second cookie exchange plus one-second POST succeeds for each recovery path.
Combined cookie exchange and POST abort at thirty seconds for each recovery path.
Shorter signed expiry wins during cookie exchange and POST for each recovery path.
Parent cancellation wins during cookie exchange and POST for each recovery path.
An ordinary epic read still aborts at ten seconds.

limitations: Local mocked transport evidence only; production acceptance was not performed.
No provider operations, host journal changes, database writes, or migration helper runs.
